outputs.explanation: Panel A consists solely of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge) with no quantitative plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.

The bar graphs (JC-1 relative Green/Red intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points (e.g., dots for each of the 20 samples) are overlaid to show the underlying spread.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.

The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar graphs display only group means with error bars (sample sizes noted inside the bars: 15/15/15 and 23/26/23), but the individual data points for each animal/section are not plotted.

Panel E shows raw FACS histograms for each of the three independent replicate experiments per condition (not an averaged/summary plot), so the underlying individual data are already directly visible and no additional individual-point overlay is required.
